dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Of note? Uh... Sure, I guess the clouds over there are perfect for staring at while you daydream. Oh, and the treasure hunter who came by to fix something did mention that...

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: It seems someone's found a new vein of Magical Crystal Ore nearby. Not my area of expertise — seeing as I'm just a humble researcher, after all. But if you're curious... Ahem, I've marked the coordinates for you.
